I made the video, and `npx hyperframes check .` passed with no findings. I didn't open a preview or inspect any frames; the check was the only verification of the visuals. The render is `studio/final.mp4`, 9.0 s long, 1080×1350 at 30 fps (270 frames, 195 KB), rendered in about 30 s.

I wrote `spec.md`, `data.json`, `story.md` and `timing.json` before building `index.html`. In the composition, Reference, Data, Story, Motion, Direct and Ship light up in turn, 1.5 s each, with the filename shown under the lit panel. The start and end times in `timing.json` match the animation.

The numbers on screen are 6 steps, 1.5 s each, 9 s total, and the panel indices 01–06. Each is in `data.json` with a source: the 9 s is computed as 6 × 1.5, and the others come from your brief.

The girth-studio skill asks for `FACTS.md`, `STORYBOARD.md`, `film.json` and a preview-then-ask before rendering. I skipped those because your instructions named different files and approved the render up front.
